title: Wessels tank: replacement bladder kit lookup

n1.text: Which tank size needs a replacement bladder?

r_B200.cause: Replacement bladder for the B200 tank (2026 cheat sheet).
fix: Tank P/N (obsolete) 116550; Bladder Kit BG (current) 189579.
Tank P/N 116051; Bladder Kit 189600.
The sheet footer reads "Amtrol-Supplied" and "Wessels-Supplied" and says all new tank orders go through Wessels; confirm which pair of columns is which on the sheet before ordering.
2026 bladder pricing is available from Amtrol, per the sheet.
